events.title: St. Joe Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
events.body: St. Joe (NYSE:JOE) reported first-quarter 2026 results highlighted by higher revenue and operating income, while net income declined due largely to lower earnings from its unconsolidated joint venture at Latitude Margaritaville Watersound.

events.title: Homebuilder Earnings: D.R. Horton Sticks Out as Pulte & NVR Sales Tank
events.body: Homebuilders continue to see significant sales and earnings declines. However, D.R. Horton delivered a solid performance in its latest quarter versus estimates.
